MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 5

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 19

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

13. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

14. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 8
   C. 64
   D. 9

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 33

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 44

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

23. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

24. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 18

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 55

26. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 20
   D. 75

27. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 7

28. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 18
   C. 22
   D. 36

29. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 105

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
